entries.value: raw material food safe per maker; maker advises against repeated eating or drinking from prints
entries.note: Prusa blog adds: no certification acquired; personal use only, not for sale.
entries.quote: Even though PLA is the material on its own is food safe, we do not suggest to repeatedly drink or eat from your 3D prints. It's because of the small fractures in the print surface, which means bacteria can build up in there over time. You can prevent this by applying a food-safe coating.

entries.value: layer grooves harbor bacteria and are almost impossible to clean
entries.note: Applies to all FDM prints.
entries.quote: The problem, with all 3d-printed objects, in general, is that they are made from layers. The grooves in between those layers are a seedbed for bacteria as they are almost impossible to clean properly, and will hold residue.
entries.source: Prusa Knowledge Base: Food safe FDM printing
entries.cite: Prusa Knowledge Base: food safe FDM printing

entries.value: Prusa does not recommend 3D prints as food containers; brass nozzles are not food safe
entries.note: The KB also says certified food-safe epoxy coatings exist, and a stainless steel or titanium nozzle is needed if food use is considered.
entries.quote: The standard brass nozzle is not considered food-safe, as it wears out. ... We do not recommend using 3d-prints as food-containers etc!
entries.source: Prusa Knowledge Base: Food safe FDM printing
entries.cite: Prusa Knowledge Base: food safe FDM printing

entries.value: FDA judges a food contact article by the regulatory status of each substance in it (21 CFR 174-179, GRAS, prior sanction, TOR, or FCN)
entries.note: This FDA page is general. It does not mention 3D printing, and no FDA page found speaks to 3D printed articles. Polymer listings are in 21 CFR 177.
entries.quote: The overall regulatory status of a food contact material is dictated by the regulatory status of each individual substance that comprises the article.
entries.source: US FDA: Determining the Regulatory Status of Components of a Food Contact Material
